repos_data.description: From Idea to Execution - Manage your trading operation across a distributed cluster
An open and opinionated trading platform using productive & familiar open source libraries and tools for strategy research, execution and operation.
A Python-based development platform for automated trading systems - from backtesting to optimisation to livetrading.
Free, open source crypto trading bot

C++ 17 based library (with sample applications) for testing equities, futures, currencies, etfs & options based automated trading ideas using DTN IQFeed real time data feed and Interactive Brokers (IB TWS API) for trade execution. libtorch/lstm/cuda demo. Support for Alpaca & Phemex. Notifications via Telegram.

Reproducible crypto-trading benchmark data: exchange API latency (p50/p95/p99), real cost-to-trade (fee + spread + slippage), and x402 blockchain settlement latency. Updated automatically. CC BY 4.0. Behind fillbench.com
A unified trading API with more than 100 crypto exchanges and prediction markets in JavaScript / TypeScript / Python / C# / PHP / Go / Java
Python framework for quantitative financial analysis and trading algorithms on decentralised exchanges

Free, open source, a high frequency trading and market making backtesting and trading bot, which accounts for limit orders, queue positions, and latencies, utilizing full tick data for trades and order books(Level-2 and Level-3), with real-world crypto trading examples for Binance and Bybit
Javascript SDK for trading on cryptocurrency exchanges like FTX, OKX, Bybit, and more. Supports API data feeds and WebSocket. Built by the Compendium Team.
AI crypto trading bot with deep neural network (84.9% accuracy, 25 coins). BiLSTM + Attention trained on GPU. Bybit, Binance, OKX, Gate.io. Free cloud or self-hosted.
Algorithmic trading and quantitative trading open source platform to develop trading robots (stock markets, forex, crypto, bitcoins, and options).
